verdict.rationale: Foreloop's docs describe agents working inside a checkout the developer already has on their machine (foreloop-docs-3, foreloop-docs-2, foreloop-docs-36), with 'foreloop init' installing a skill into an existing checkout rather than the agent autonomously cloning the repo, installing dependencies, or configuring its environment. No evidence anywhere describes automated cloning, dependency installation, or environment setup by the agent itself.
